args.body:
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4.

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions are <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0; fixed in 2.9.4. This bumps requirements.txt to fastjson==2.9.4. No other dependencies are changed. CI run ci-0001 passed on this branch.
args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 (fixes CVE-2026-31337)
